transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?
Ever since they changed my position at the shop, I just can’t seem to adjust, and it’s throwing off my work and my whole routine. I'm just finding it really hard to cope with the changes.
Have you been feeling down or lost interest in things you usually enjoy, even when things aren’t stressful?

Yes, I've completely lost interest in the things I used to love. Instead of working on my metal sculptures, paddle-boarding, or playing pickleball, I just end up sitting on the couch feeling defeated and wound up. I've even been backing out of plans with my friends because I just don't have the energy for any of it anymore.
Have these feelings of losing interest and feeling down been happening most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?

Yes, it's been a constant, daily struggle for about a month now, starting just a week or two after the transition. It really feels like an everyday cloud of dread and defeat hanging over me, both while I'm at work and when I get home.
Have you also been feeling hopeless, or do you find yourself thinking that life isn't worth living?

No, I definitely don't have any thoughts of wanting to harm myself or feeling like life isn't worth living. I just feel incredibly defeated and stuck because of this job situation, but it's really about how much this work change has disrupted my life rather than feeling hopeless about everything.
Have you noticed any improvement in your mood or energy, even briefly, when something positive happens or when you're around loved ones?
To be honest, I haven't really noticed any improvement in my mood. I've mostly been avoiding socializing altogether and just haven't felt up to being around people lately, even my family.
